findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_reading_sources, run_discovery_workflow, get_service_evidence, recommend_services, get_benchmark_suite, get_task_options · Private data: search_reading_sources, search_llm_providers, search_discovered_services, get_service_evidence, recommend_services, get_benchmark_suite, get_connection_handoff · Public sink: run_discovery_workflow, search_discovered_services, find_service_alternatives, recommend_services, plan_benchmark, get_task_options · Destructive: run_discovery_workflow, search_discovered_services, get_service_evidence, get_benchmark_suite, search_services, get_connection_handoff, get_task_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_reading_sources, run_discovery_workflow, get_service_evidence, recommend_services, get_benchmark_suite, get_task_options · Private data: search_reading_sources, search_llm_providers, search_discovered_services, get_service_evidence, recommend_services, get_benchmark_suite, get_connection_handoff · Public sink: run_discovery_workflow, search_discovered_services, find_service_alternatives, recommend_services, plan_benchmark, get_task_options · Destructive: run_discovery_workflow, search_discovered_services, get_service_evidence, get_benchmark_suite, search_services, get_connection_handoff, get_task_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
